label.purpose: Piece meta, clip headers, segmented buttons.

shadows.name: bevel
shadows.purpose: Raised top highlight on panels and toolbar.

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-tbtn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:26px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--line, #1c2124); border-radius:2px; background:linear-gradient(#56616a,#48525a); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #6c7880; color:#d3d9dc; font:12px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tbtn:hover { background:linear-gradient(#5f6b74,#505b63); } .ds-tbtn:active { box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); background:#444d54; } .ds-tbtn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ff9a1f; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Button On
components.description: Active toggle or primary action in orange.
components.css: .ds-tbtn-on { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:26px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid #1c2124; border-radius:2px; background:linear-gradient(#ffad45,#f08a10); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffd199; color:#1d1a14; font:600 12px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tbtn-on:active { box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); } .ds-tbtn-on:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ff9a1f; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Sunken well input; border turns orange on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; height:28px; padding:0 8px; background:#2a3034; border:1px solid #1c2124; border-radius:2px; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:#ff9a1f; } .ds-search input { flex:1; background:none; border:0; outline:none; color:#d3d9dc; font:12px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:#8d999f; }

components.name: Type Filter
components.css: .ds-seg { display:flex; border:1px solid #1c2124; border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-seg button { flex:1; padding:4px 8px; border:0; border-right:1px solid #1c2124; background:#4a545b; color:#d3d9dc; font:11px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-seg button.on { background:#ff9a1f; color:#1d1a14; font-weight:600; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ff9a1f; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Bevelled slate panel with steel title bar.
components.css: .ds-panel { background:#343b40; border:1px solid #1c2124; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #5b676f; color:#d3d9dc; font:12px/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; padding:8px; } .ds-title { margin:0; height:24px; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 8px; background:linear-gradient(#58636b,#4a545b); border-bottom:1px solid #1c2124; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Playlist Clip
components.description: Type-coloured pattern clip carrying name and author; the user's own clip is orange.
components.html:
Montuno in Amana
Montuno forkyou
components.css: .ds-clips { display:flex; gap:4px; padding:4px; background:#2a3034; } .ds-clip { width:160px; height:46px; border:1px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--tc) 30%, #2a3034); } .ds-clip-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:6px; padding:0 5px; background:var(--tc); color:#15191b; font:600 11px/15px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-clip-head .by { font-weight:400; opacity:0.85; } .ds-clip.mine .ds-clip-head { background:#ff9a1f; }

components.name: Diff Notes
components.description: Piano-roll diff states: same grey, new green, deleted red ghost, moved yellow with dashed ghost.
components.css: .ds-roll { position:relative; width:260px; height:60px; background:#2e353a; } .ds-roll .n { position:absolute; width:40px; height:13px; border-radius:2px; border:1px solid #355f24; background:#8bd16b; } .ds-roll .same { background:#6c777d; border-color:#4b5459; } .ds-roll .new { background:#46e06a; border-color:#1d6b31; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgb(70 224 106 / 0.35); } .ds-roll .del { background:rgb(255 90 82 / 0.16); border:1.5px dashed #ff5a52; } .ds-roll .was { background:transparent; border:1px dashed rgb(255 210 63 / 0.6); } .ds-roll .mov { background:#ffd23f; border-color:#7a6110; }

components.name: LCD Readout
components.description: Sunken tempo display with orange mono digits.
components.css: .ds-lcd { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; height:28px; padding:0 8px; background:#171b1d; border:1px solid #1c2124; border-radius:2px; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); color:#ff9a1f; font:600 13px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-lcd span { font-size:10px; color:#c27720; }

narrative.overview:
Lineage looks and behaves like the DAW judges already know: FL Studio's default theme and working layout (Browser left, Playlist over Piano Roll in the centre, a dock on the right), in FL's own slate-and-orange palette. This is a pinned brand commitment: FL's conventions and colours, never its logo, fruit mark or name.

The difference is that authorship is drawn into the instrument itself, not parked in a side panel. Every playlist clip header, browser row and piano-roll title names its author and licence; the user's own pieces burn orange everywhere they appear. Density is high (12px UI, 2–3px gutters, 24–28px controls) because this is a working tool, not a landing page.
keyCharacteristics: Slate panels with 1px top-light / bottom-dark bevels and near-black hairline borders.
Orange is the single "live" signal: active toggles, play, focus, playhead, and "this is yours".
Piece type is colour-coded once and reused across clips, browser rows and tree nodes.
Tabular mono readouts in sunken LCD wells.

rules.name: The You Are Orange Rule
rules.body: A piece whose author is the current user renders orange wherever authorship shows: clip header and mini-roll, credits name, tree node head and border. No other piece may use orange as its identity colour.

rules.name: The One Map Rule
rules.body: Piece-type colours and diff colours are separate vocabularies. Never reuse a type colour to mean a diff state or vice versa.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Tempo, bar numbers, pitch/beat/length readouts and piece ids are monospace; prose never is.

rules.name: The Bevel Not Float Rule
rules.body: In-app chrome is raised or sunken with 1px insets. Drop shadows are reserved for windows and graph nodes.

dos: Do use orange (#ff9a1f) only for live state, focus, the playhead, and the current user's pieces.
Do colour a piece by its type through the shared type variable so clips, browser stripes and tree heads stay in sync.
Do keep the diff mapping fixed: green new, red dashed ghost deleted, yellow moved with dashed ghost and connector, grey unchanged.
Do show author and licence wherever a piece is shown.
Do keep raised/sunken depth to 1px insets and 2px corners.
donts: Don't use FL Studio's logo, fruit mark or name anywhere.
Don't give a non-user piece an orange identity, or use a type colour to signal a diff state.
Don't put drop shadows on in-app chrome; they belong to the tree window and nodes.
Don't use dashed borders except for diff ghosts.
